description: List the authenticated user's game server instances. Supports optional filters by game, location, deploy status, whether the server is running, and fuzzy name match. Returns instance summaries including id, name, game, `status` (whether it is deployed or archived), `hibernating` (a Lite server that is asleep and needs wake_instance before anyone can join), `server_status` (whether it is actually running) with a display label and player count, location, and network info.

game.description: Filter by game. Matches module slug (e.g. "gmod"), nodepanel id, or a substring of the game's title.

location.description: Filter by location id (e.g. "us-chicago") or a case-insensitive substring of the location name.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the instance name.

server_status.description: Filter by live run state, e.g. "offline" to find servers that are currently down. Hibernating instances have no run state and are excluded by any value here.

status.description: Filter by deploy status (whether the server occupies a slot, not whether it is running). Use `server_status` for that. Defaults to "deployed", which also includes hibernating Lite servers, since they keep their slot while asleep.

name: list_instances
title: List Instances
